crossRefs.note: All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.
Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
Sing to Yahweh a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is…
The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me, because I give water in the wilderness and…
Sing, you heavens, for Yahweh has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains…
Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains, for Yahweh has comforted his people, and will…
saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength…
Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!
Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.

translations.web: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!
translations.bsb: Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!
translations.kjv: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.
translations.asv: Bless Jehovah, all ye his works, In all places of his dominion: Bless Jehovah, O my soul.
